about.heroBody: At SRSS, education begins with a simple belief: every child carries within them the capacity for wisdom, kindness and purposeful action.
about.heroAlt: SRSS pupils gathered at a school assembly
about.foundingTitle: A school built on what matters most.
about.foundingBody: Sekolah Rendah Sathya Sai was established to offer an education in which strong learning and strong character belong together. Inspired by the education vision of Sathya Sai Baba, the school seeks to draw out the human values already present in every child.
about.foundingSupport: SRSS is part of a worldwide family of Sathya Sai schools: locally rooted, globally connected, and united by a commitment to academic confidence, compassionate leadership and service to society.

valueWeek.prompt: Notice one thoughtful way you can make someone’s day lighter.

principal.heading: Every child deserves to be known.
principal.quote: Our work is not only to help children succeed in school, but to help them grow into people who can bring courage, care and clarity to the world around them.
principal.body: SRSS is a community of educators, families and pupils learning together. We hold high expectations with warmth, and create space for every child to discover both their strengths and their responsibility to others.
principal.alt: An SRSS pupil sharing a reflection at school
